summary: Major NVIDIA partnership ($500M deal, 3 new factories in TX/NC, 10x optical connectivity capacity, 50% fiber capacity) drove 12% Wednesday rally. Oppenheimer raised PT to $210 from $120 on May 7. Springboard growth plan extended through 2030, targeting $35B sales (internal $40B). Earlier in week (May 3) The Motley Fool noted GLW had plummeted before the rally.
